prompts.mugStudio: Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic premium fashion editorial lifestyle photograph, portrait 4:5. The two supplied official Printful images show opposite sides of ONE white glossy 11 oz cylindrical ceramic mug. Preserve the exact mug proportions, white interior, rounded white handle, and printed design. Show ONLY the red emblem face toward the camera, handle on viewer left, matching reference 2 precisely; the wordmark is on the opposite hidden side, never combine both faces or invent branding. Scene: stylish adult woman around 30 with short dark bob, charcoal ribbed sweater, wide-leg dark trousers, seated at a minimal walnut desk in a beautiful concrete artist studio, holding the mug naturally at chest height in her LEFT hand, fingers through handle without covering emblem. Quiet confident candid presence; torso and face visible, mug prominent and sharply focused, realistic 11 oz scale. Late autumn daylight through tall window, soft warm practical light, deep charcoal and warm wood, subtle cool blue shadows, analog editorial grain, high-end independent fashion magazine. No Halloween or holiday decorations; evergreen store imagery. Natural skin and hands, anatomically correct fingers. No captions, no added logos, no extra mug, no watermark. Product fidelity takes priority over styling. Supplied product artwork is fixed, do not redesign emblem.
